方々: 方々から = ほうぼう 'from all over/many places', not かたがた 'people'
鬼: 鬼仁会 is a clan name; 鬼 is part of the name
切れ: 時間切れ = 'time's up/expired'; 切れ is suffix 'running out', not 'piece'
狒々: ヒヒ is a sly laugh 'hehe', not baboon/lecher
鏝: 使こて = 使(つか)って (Kansai te-form), not 'iron/trowel'
跳ね: 跳ねっかえり (tomboy/rebellious person) compound, not 'jump'
収まり: おさまりつかん = idiom 'can't be settled', fine but verb-ish compound
元: 元をたどれば idiom 'if you trace it back to the origin'
